page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.medium is an x86_64 virtual server provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is allocated 16 dedicated vCPUs alongside 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1.0 GB RAM allocation per virtual core. It includes no local storage drives and contains no GPU accelerators.

The 1:1 vCPU-to-memory ratio represents a high core-density configuration suited for compute-heavy execution where RAM capacity requirements remain minimal. Because the instance contains zero local disk storage, persistent data management requires external block storage volumes. Non-accelerated execution mandates that all workload processing depends strictly on the dedicated x86_64 host CPUs.

Given the dense vCPU allocation relative to system memory, this hardware profile fits parallel computation, software compilation, batch job processing, and CPU-bound analytical tasks that do not demand large operational memory footprints.

Persistent data storage relies on external network storage options. The configuration aligns with parallel compute execution, software compilation, batch processing, and CPU-bound analytical tasks.
